issues: Pool card header still reads '<n> available in DIV-IND + child districts' even when MPCA is viewing — spec calls for wording that reflects the wider ALL-players scope. Cosmetic; the underlying pool IS state-wide (5000 limit fetch, 257 loaded).

action_items: (minor cosmetic) In SquadDetail.jsx line ~382, when persona.body_type==='State' render header like 'X available across MPCA state' instead of the hardcoded 'in <body_id> + child districts' string.
critical_code_review_comments: SquadDetail.jsx canEdit rule allows MPCA to edit officials even on Approved squads (isMPCA short-circuits without checking status). Spec text said 'enabled while the squad is not Approved (they can also edit after Reopen)'. Backend actually permits it too (is_mpca bypasses the Awaiting/Approved guard). Either tighten FE to require Reopen OR loosen spec wording — currently FE and BE agree with each other but slightly deviate from spec. Non-blocking.

SelectionPatch model still has match_officials field but M34 introduces a dedicated /squads/{sid}/officials PATCH. Consider removing match_officials from SelectionPatch to keep a single source of truth (currently a Division could still update officials via the legacy /tournaments/{tid}/selection PATCH bypassing the new workflow guard).

SquadOfficialsSection.save() posts every slot on save (payload[s.key] = officials[s.key] || null) — sending null for cleared slots is fine, but it means an untouched empty field also POSTs null overwriting any prior value. Backend uses exclude_unset so this specific request actually sets ALL keys — desired here. Just calling it out.
TournamentSubTabs.jsx computes squad_url via an extra /tournaments/{id} + /squads GET on every mount — memoize per tournamentId to avoid redundant network calls on tab switches.

TournamentDetail.jsx box-squad fallback still navigates to `/tournaments/${id}/selection` if targetBody is null — this is the only remaining code path that could lead a user to the legacy console via UI click. Consider replacing with a friendly 'No host body configured' notice.
